<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission Oversight:</strong> The ECI has reshuffled internal work allocation, placing IT Chief Seema Khanna under the supervision of a Senior Deputy Election Commissioner.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election Integrity Debate:</strong> The BJP has countered Congress allegations regarding election results by highlighting the NDA&#x27;s strike rate and dismissing claims of electoral malpractice as false propaganda.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W6</a></span></li>
